notes: First Italian register found that carries an age field. eta_presunta is a band, not a figure: '< 100', '100-200', '> 200', 'Non applicabile'.

Also carries a removal status inline, which is Italy's usual missing vitality field: 378 listed, 11 removed for natural death, 2 removed by felling. Lazio publishes the same thing as a separate sheet; Piemonte keeps it in the same layer.
oggetto_di_identif mechanically separates single trees from GRUPPO, VIALE ALBERATO, FILARE SINGOLO and FILARE DOPPIO, so avenues and stands can be filtered without reading names.
tipo_proprieta settles hard rule 10 without a site visit: Pubblica / Privata / Sia pubblica che privata.
MASAF's national file repeats these coordinates and girths exactly for Torino, so national and regional are one survey and not two independent sources.

Register ids encode the comune: L219 is Torino. Trees the local press counts as Turin's are sometimes filed under a neighbouring comune, which is why city counts of 15 or 16 do not match the 14 in this layer.
